courses.overview: 以可遷移的傳力原理、施工方法與驗證比較相近的隧道與地下設施；關聯不表示同一業主、設計者、年代或規範。
courses.overviewEn: Compare neighbouring tunnels and underground works through transferable load-path principles, construction methods and verification; a link does not imply the same owner, designer, era or code.

related.title: 隧道噴射混凝土支護
related.transfer: 可遷移「節理出露幾何」與「排水恢復摩擦」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；隧道噴射混凝土支護的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" and "Drainage and friction recovery" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Shotcrete tunnel support must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定；隧道噴射混凝土支護則以以早齡承載、基面黏結與厚度控制噴凝土支護為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums; Shotcrete tunnel support centres on control shotcrete support through early strength, substrate bond and installed thickness, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「節理出露幾何」與「薄殼受力與岩面接觸」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到隧道噴射混凝土支護，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「芯樣方向與強度換算」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” and “Shell action and rock contact”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Shotcrete tunnel support, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Core orientation and strength interpretation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

related.title: 地下結構浮力穩定
related.transfer: 可遷移「節理出露幾何」與「排水恢復摩擦」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；地下結構浮力穩定的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Discontinuity daylighting geometry" and "Drainage and friction recovery" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Uplift stability of underground structures must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定；地下結構浮力穩定則以以外水壓、有效重量與施工階段判讀地下結構抗浮為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums; Uplift stability of underground structures centres on evaluate underground uplift through external water pressure, effective weight and construction stages, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「節理出露幾何」與「外包排水體積」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到地下結構浮力穩定，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「底板局部彎曲」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Discontinuity daylighting geometry” and “Displaced envelope volume”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Uplift stability of underground structures, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Local slab bending", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 岩石邊坡錨固與監測
history.text: 本課以公開工程研究與機構文件建立從節理幾何、錨固荷載與量測基準判讀岩坡穩定的背景。寶珊於一九八〇年代設置水平排水改善水位（1980s）。美國聯邦公路管理局出版地錨系統手冊（1999）。香港場地勘察指南列出更新版本（2017）。兩個地標用來比較環境、量測與維護證據，並非宣稱本課每一教學構件都實際用於兩處。來源若只可讀摘要，適用範圍已另行註明；現場設計須重新確認規範版本與責任。本課只重建公開原理。
history.textEn: This course uses public research and institutional documents to establish context for interpret rock slope stability through discontinuity geometry, anchor loads and measurement datums. Horizontal drainage is installed at Po Shan during the1980s (1980s). FHWA publishes its ground-anchor systems manual (1999). Hong Kong lists an updated site-investigation guide (2017). The two landmarks compare environments, measurements and maintenance evidence; they do not imply that every teaching component was installed at both sites. Abstract-only access is declared in source scopes. Field design requires current applicability and responsible review. This course reconstructs public principles only.
